script.speaker: student
script.text: Can I change my Saturday shift? I have an exam on Monday.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: I can move you to Sunday afternoon, but then you lose the weekend bonus.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: About two hundred lira a month. Some students keep Saturday and study at night.

script.speaker: student
script.text: I'll take Sunday. Two hundred lira is not worth a bad grade.

question.stem: Why does the student choose the Sunday shift?

options.B: The exam matters more to her than the bonus
options.D: She is not allowed to work at night
options.E: The manager asked her to change

question.explain_tr: Öğrenci parayı 'kötü bir nota değmez' diyerek sınavı önceliyor. Pazar vardiyası daha çok değil, primi kaybettirdiği için daha az kazandırıyor.
question.key_line: Two hundred lira is not worth a bad grade.
